messages:
Ben: Quick summary — p95 drift on /generate-chat for tier=pro over the last 3 deploys. Graphs in perf-bot link. Thinking dynamic token-budgets per route/tier + kernel favoring low-latency small-batch path. Thoughts?
Alyssa: saw that :eyes: p95 jumped from ~220ms -> ~310ms, KV hit rate down ~8% on the same shard.
Ben: yeah KV miss spike aligns with microbatch re-org at commit abc123. perf snapshot attached.
perf-bot: [auto] Profile snapshot uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/profiles/4943210000/flame.svg
Raj: Can we try route-scoped token caps? e.g. config suggestion: `route_budget = {"/generate-chat": {"pro": 40, "free": 20}}` and enforce early-cutoff for prefix-heavy requests.
Carla: also we should bias kernel selection to fast path when batch_size <= 6 and seq_len <= 128 — avoids the heavy attention kernel that spikes latency.
Ben: Proposed canary payload (quick):
```json
{"canary": {"selector": "route==/generate-chat && tier==pro", "token_budget": 40, "kernel_preference": "low_latency_v2", "kv_prefetch": true}}
```
Alyssa: add instrumentation please: token_budget_used, batch_size, kernel_chosen, kv_hit boolean per request. Need histograms for batch_size and seq_len.
Raj: will wire metrics: batcher.token_budget_used, batcher.kernel_choice, batcher.kv_hit. Will also emit batcher.seq_len_hist.
Carla: I'll prep a 10k request load test at production QPS with mixed seq lengths (30/80/200) and a small prefix-heavy subset.
Ben: success criteria: p95 <= 280ms on canary, kv_hit recovers to within 2% of baseline, and no throughput regressions. If metrics good, roll to 20% traffic.
Alyssa: ack. I can watch dashboards and set a temporary p95 alert at 300ms for the canary slice.
Raj: starting canary on stage-2 at 4943210020, job logs: jobs/ci/4943210020.log — posting progress here.
perf-bot: canary started 4943210020, baseline profile diff: s3://redwood-perf/diffs/4943210000-vs-baseline.html
Carla: first run results: microbatch distribution shifted left (median batch_size 3 -> 2), kernel_choice leaned heavy attention ~18% -> 36%. That matches the regressions.
Ben: hmm that explains it. New plan: tighten batcher.queue_timeout for this selector so we don't favor very small batches and explicitly prefer low_latency_v2 kernel when seq_len <= 128.
Raj: will push a 2-line change to batcher: reduce small-batch timeout from 6ms -> 3ms for the selector and add kernel override.
Alyssa: re-run load test after Raj's change, I'll watch p95 & kv_hit.
Raj: change pushed and canary restarted 4943210060. Logs: jobs/ci/4943210060.log
perf-bot: canary update 4943210060: p95 dropped to ~265ms, kv_hit recovered to within 1.5% of baseline.
Carla: model outputs checked on a sample set — no regressions in tokens or formatting.
Ben: great. Proceed to 20% rollout tomorrow morning after another overnight run. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Alyssa: noted. I'll prepare the rollout play and rollback criterion.
Raj: leaving the telemetry hooks for 48h. Ping here for anomalies.
Ben: if anything spikes, hit the rollback flag and ping eng-oncall.
